Bosch GKS 18V-51 Professional cordless circular saw offers unrestricted movement and effortless cutting. Designed for cross-cutting timber, ripping plywood and OSB boards, and also making bevel cuts in timber. Features a powerful 18V brushless motor, ideal for cutting large quantities of plywood boards on a daily basis. Compact, lightweight design enables portability and effortless vertical and horizontal cuts. Also features an improved dust extraction port design, and ergonomic handle for comfort. Max. cutting capacity of 51mm at 0° and 35mm at 45°.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
